source_inspection: Approved dossier inspected from attached PNG; all four Higgsfield PNGs reopened and displayed in this work session.

view_naming.front: Face toward viewer; character RIGHT appears screen-left.
view_naming.rear: Back toward viewer; character RIGHT appears screen-right.
view_naming.screen_left_profile: Nose points screen-left. This image-direction label is not anatomical LEFT; use physical garment correspondence to identify the visible side.
view_naming.screen_right_profile: Nose points screen-right. This image-direction label is not anatomical RIGHT.
view_naming.correction: Earlier generation prompts mixed screen-facing direction and anatomical camera side. Preserve existing source names, but never propagate that ambiguity into bone or garment L/R identifiers.

parts.observed: Mature anime face in approved design; independently generated profiles are not a measured rotation.
parts.correction: Preserve approved facial identity, eye shape, jaw, nose and neck; same head dimensions in all views. No new expression set.

parts.observed: Long dark-brown layered face-framing hair; original gold hair accessory must not migrate between sides.
parts.correction: Keep same fringe and accessory attached to the same physical side; screen position changes with camera.

parts.observed: Left-facing profile has a strongly wind-swept expanded back mass; right-facing profile hangs closer to body. Rear obscures much of the back.
parts.correction: Reconcile one long, voluminous wavy hairstyle with gravity-down neutral fall, matching length and back-of-head-to-hip volume. Do not shorten hair or flatten the character design. Do not infer hidden back anatomy as verified.

parts.observed: Ivory fitted low-neckline blouse with original approved bust silhouette.
parts.correction: Maintain neckline, coverage, fit and adult proportions; profile must be true side projection, not frontal double-breast rendering.

parts.observed: Front has a continuous long fitted black corset to the waist belt. Right-facing profile adds a bare midriff break absent from front.
parts.correction: Restore continuous long corset in the right-facing profile; keep original chest and thigh exposure unchanged. Carry seams and buckle rows around one torso instead of inventing a cropped top.

parts.observed: Front uses layered angular black-and-gold shoulder/upper-arm plates; right-facing profile simplifies them into a rounded shell with different arm coverage.
parts.correction: Use the same approved angular armor components and their overlaps in every view; retain distinct left/right identifiers. Avoid heavy armor redesign.

parts.observed: Wrist guard shapes and gold plate breaks differ between images.
parts.correction: Preserve glove length, fingers, wrist boundary and the same identifiable plate arrangement. Common neutral A-pose; no independent arm posing.

parts.observed: Front has multiple waist belts and side pouches; side/rear images invent different buckle and pouch placement.
parts.correction: Use front only as working placement guide under approved ART-001. Map each visible pouch to the same belt/hip; hidden buckle backs remain a modeling proposal, not claimed source fact.

parts.observed: Short black combat overskirt and fitted underlayer preserve a readable hip/thigh silhouette.
parts.correction: Match hem height and waist attachment across views. Do not replace with trousers, a long skirt or a new costume.

parts.observed: Front working reference shows exposed upper thigh with horizontal dark bands and a vertical buckle strap on character RIGHT (viewer-left). Rear incorrectly exposes banded skin on both thighs; right-facing profile also reproduces that near-side exposed thigh.
parts.correction: Keep exposed strapped RIGHT thigh on front viewer-left and rear viewer-right. Carry the same bands around that physical leg. Do not duplicate the exposed strapped arrangement onto the opposite leg.

parts.observed: Front character LEFT thigh (viewer-right) has continuous dark legwear instead of the exposed strap arrangement.
parts.correction: Preserve continuous dark left legwear on rear viewer-left and the appropriate near side of the right-facing profile. This is preserving existing asymmetry, not increasing overall outfit coverage.

parts.observed: Distinct split hip-hung crimson cloth panels have inconsistent widths, attachment, lengths and rune positions across the generated views.
parts.correction: Use two identifiable asymmetric side/rear panels with fixed hip attachments, shared hem heights per panel, matching gold rune placement and gravity-down drape. No wind, no new shoulder cape, no central full-body cover. Original intentional asymmetry is retained; hidden construction is a review proposal.

parts.observed: Tall dark armored heeled boots; knee plates, gold lines and heel silhouettes vary in profiles.
parts.correction: Keep one knee-plate design, boot shaft height, heel height and sole construction; align knee/ankle/sole levels. Preserve separate left/right boot identity.

parts.observed: Modeling views are empty-handed; approved rifle exists separately in ART-001.
parts.correction: No rifle in this turnaround. Future weapon attachment and two-hand grips remain separate work.

landmark_policy.method: Redraw the candidate to one common reference height and neutral pose; only uniform whole-view scaling/translation is permitted for registration. Do not stretch individual body regions to fabricate agreement.
landmark_policy.limits: Visible clothing landmarks are not measured joint centers. No precise 3D body dimensions are claimed from these images.

correction_image_brief.deliverable: One new clean four-view character turnaround correction sheet R1, not another decorative dossier and not a 3D mesh. Four full-body views: front, nose-left profile, rear, nose-right profile. Equal scale and baseline, same neutral A-pose physically viewed from each angle.
correction_image_brief.visual_authority: Use attached approved VIYA dossier as identity/style authority; use reopened generated views only to locate the concrete conflicts described above.
correction_image_brief.preserve: Adult mature glamorous character, full original curvy silhouette, narrow corseted waist, original ivory low neckline and exposed areas, long dark wavy hair, charcoal black/antique-gold armor, crimson split cloth and expressive hand-inked dark fantasy anime treatment. No photorealism and no generic game-doll redesign.
correction_image_brief.targeted_changes: Correct inconsistent hair rest shape; restore long corset in side view; fix physical right-thigh straps versus left dark legwear; map the same shoulder, belt, pouch, boot and crimson cloth parts through all four views. Do not use a mirrored copy as the opposite costume side.
correction_image_brief.presentation: Warm neutral plain background, no scenery or weapon, thin common alignment guides only, full uncropped figures with separated panel spacing, brief labels FRONT / PROFILE LEFT / BACK / PROFILE RIGHT and subtitle CONSISTENCY CANDIDATE R1. No detailed lore panels or close-up sexual framing.
correction_image_brief.generation_channel: ChatGPT image generation correction candidate; no additional paid Higgsfield generation authorized or submitted in this work unit.
correction_image_brief.approval: Candidate only. Requires actual output inspection and producer approval; do not mark model-ready solely because an image was generated.

review_rules: Compare named parts and anatomical side ownership, not overall mirrored silhouette IoU as a pass/fail threshold.
Preserve original files and do not change BREAKERS or Viya main.
Separate observed source content from inferred hidden construction and proposed repairs.
Do not rig the rejected SAM 3D mesh. No new character, costume, skill or gameplay expansion in this unit.
